summary: An open-source native image editor in Rust (storytold/photocraft): a Cargo workspace of focused crates under crates/, with desktop, CLI and web apps under apps/. Assumption: tests that live next to the code as *_tests.rs files belong to the campus, not to their crate's district.

zones.name: Pixels, colour and the document
zones.purpose: Geometry, colour and colour management, raster buffers and the layered document model every other crate builds on.

zones.name: Image processing
zones.purpose: Filters, painting, compositing, vector and text rendering, and the sandboxed plug-in filters.

zones.name: Editor engine
zones.purpose: The editor's commands, presets and state on top of every processing crate.

zones.name: File formats
zones.purpose: Reading and writing images and documents: codecs, PSD/PSB, camera raw, Affinity and the native bundle.

zones.name: GPU
zones.purpose: GPU compositing and its WGSL shaders.

zones.name: Editor UI
zones.purpose: The egui editor: tool panels, dialogs, the canvas shell, translations and pen tablet input.

zones.name: Apps and automation
zones.purpose: The desktop, CLI and web apps, and the MCP server that drives the engine.

zones.name: Build and release
zones.purpose: xtask, packaging, perf and scorecard tooling, and the workspace configuration.

zones.name: Tests and examples
zones.purpose: Unit tests next to the code, crate test suites, the test kit and examples.
